definition_en: to make a bad situation better
example_en: New policies may ameliorate air pollution.
example_uz: Yangi siyosatlar havo ifloslanishini yaxshilashi mumkin.

definition_en: caused by human activity
example_en: Anthropogenic emissions are warming the planet.
example_uz: Inson faoliyatidan kelgan chiqindilar sayyorani isitmoqda.

definition_en: obviously true and needing no proof
example_en: It is axiomatic that evidence matters in science.
example_uz: Ilmda dalil muhimligi o'z-o'zidan ayon.

definition_en: to divide into two branches
example_en: The river will bifurcate near the valley.
example_uz: Daryo vodiy yaqinida ikki tarmoqqa bo'linadi.

definition_en: the relationship between cause and effect
example_en: The study examines causality between diet and health.
example_uz: Tadqiqot ovqatlanish va sog'liq orasidagi sababiy bog'liqlikni o'rganadi.

definition_en: the order in which events happened
example_en: The report presents a clear chronology of events.
example_uz: Hisobot voqealarning aniq ketma-ketligini beradi.

definition_en: likely to cause disagreement
example_en: The proposal remains contentious among scholars.
example_uz: Taklif olimlar orasida hamon bahsli.

definition_en: the origin or process of obtaining something
example_en: The derivation of the formula is explained in class.
example_uz: Formula kelib chiqishi darsda tushuntiriladi.

definition_en: to make something clear
example_en: The diagram helps elucidate the process.
example_uz: Diagram jarayonni aniq tushuntirishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: to estimate beyond known information
example_en: Scientists extrapolate future trends from current data.
example_uz: Olimlar hozirgi ma'lumotlardan kelajak tendensiyalarini chiqaradilar.

definition_en: based on reasoning from evidence
example_en: Inferential reasoning is essential for this question.
example_uz: Bu savol uchun xulosaga asoslangan fikrlash muhim.

definition_en: to place things together for comparison
example_en: The author juxtaposes rural and urban life.
example_uz: Muallif qishloq va shahar hayotini yonma-yon taqqoslaydi.

definition_en: the study of forms and structures
example_en: Morphology explains how many words are formed.
example_uz: Morfologiya ko'p so'zlar qanday yasalishini tushuntiradi.

definition_en: having many different aspects
example_en: Poverty is a multidimensional social issue.
example_uz: Qashshoqlik ko'p qirrali ijtimoiy muammodir.

definition_en: to examine very carefully
example_en: Reviewers scrutinize every claim in the article.
example_uz: Taqrizchilar maqoladagi har bir fikrni sinchiklab tekshiradilar.

definition_en: a system for classifying things
example_en: Biologists use taxonomy to classify organisms.
example_uz: Biologlar organizmlarni tasniflash uchun taksonomiyadan foydalanadilar.

definition_en: happening at the same time as something else
example_en: Stress can be a concomitant effect of unemployment.
example_uz: Stress ishsizlik bilan birga yuz beradigan oqibat bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: the coming together of two or more things
example_en: A confluence of factors caused the crisis.
example_uz: Omillarning birlashishi inqirozga sabab bo'ldi.

definition_en: to break down into simpler parts
example_en: Leaves decompose quickly in warm soil.
example_uz: Barglar iliq tuproqda tez parchalanadi.

definition_en: something that causes harm
example_en: Noise can be a detriment to concentration.
example_uz: Shovqin diqqatni jamlashga zarar bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: relating to reasoning through opposing ideas
example_en: The essay uses a dialectical method of argument.
example_uz: Insho dalillashning dialektik usulidan foydalanadi.

definition_en: the gradual spreading of something
example_en: The diffusion of technology changed education.
example_uz: Texnologiyaning tarqalishi ta'limni o'zgartirdi.

definition_en: to reveal information that was secret
example_en: The researchers cannot divulge participant names.
example_uz: Tadqiqotchilar ishtirokchilar ismlarini oshkor qila olmaydilar.

definition_en: naturally found in a particular place
example_en: This bird is endemic to the island.
example_uz: Bu qush faqat shu orolga xos.

definition_en: to establish something so firmly that it is hard to change
example_en: Repeated habits can entrench inequality.
example_uz: Takrorlanadigan odatlar tengsizlikni chuqur ildiz ottirishi mumkin.

definition_en: relating to the study of cultures
example_en: The ethnographic study observed daily village life.
example_uz: Etnografik tadqiqot qishloqning kundalik hayotini kuzatdi.

definition_en: relating to the Earth and its rocks
example_en: The region has a complex geologic history.
example_uz: Hudud murakkab geologik tarixga ega.

definition_en: made of different types of things
example_en: The sample was heterogeneous in composition.
example_uz: Namuna tarkibi turli xil edi.

definition_en: marking the first event in a series
example_en: The journal published its inaugural issue in May.
example_uz: Jurnal may oyida ilk sonini chiqardi.

definition_en: to represent an abstract idea in a specific example
example_en: The experiment instantiates the theory in practice.
example_uz: Tajriba nazariyani amalda ro'yobga chiqaradi.

definition_en: the state of depending on each other
example_en: Trade creates interdependence between nations.
example_uz: Savdo davlatlar o'rtasida o'zaro bog'liqlik yaratadi.

definition_en: a person or organization between two parties
example_en: An intermediary helped the two sides reach agreement.
example_uz: Vositachi ikki tomonning kelishuviga yordam berdi.

definition_en: many and varied
example_en: The policy has manifold effects on families.
example_uz: Siyosat oilalarga ko'p xil ta'sir ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: the condition of being socially or economically outside the main group
example_en: The paper explores marginality in urban communities.
example_uz: Maqola shahar jamoalaridagi chekka holatni o'rganadi.

definition_en: just beginning to exist or develop
example_en: The nascent industry needs skilled workers.
example_uz: Endi rivojlanayotgan soha malakali xodimlarga muhtoj.

definition_en: a system of names used in a subject
example_en: Medical nomenclature can be difficult to learn.
example_uz: Tibbiy atamalar tizimini o'rganish qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.

definition_en: a rapid increase in number
example_en: The proliferation of apps changed communication.
example_uz: Ilovalarning tez ko'payishi muloqotni o'zgartirdi.

definition_en: needed for a particular purpose
example_en: Applicants need the requisite academic skills.
example_uz: Arizachilarga zarur akademik ko'nikmalar kerak.

definition_en: formed from material deposited over time
example_en: The fossils were found in sedimentary rock.
example_uz: Qoldiqlar cho'kindi jinsda topildi.

definition_en: very influential in later development
example_en: The book was seminal in modern linguistics.
example_uz: Kitob zamonaviy tilshunoslik uchun juda muhim bo'lgan.
